items.title: Xtasis accelerates medical research and scientific writing with AWS
items.summary: Dr. Adrienne Kline and her company Xtasis built three AI-powered tools on AWS: PixelGuard, NoteGuard, and CiteGeist. They automate the manual busywork of medical research, from de-identifying medical images and clinical notes to managing and verifying academic citations, giving researchers back months of time for science.
items.creator: Shashank Tanksali
